districts.name: Fairview
districts.verbatim_quote: The Fairview district is in southeast Churchill County, 42 miles southeast of Fallon on the west slope of Fairview Peak.

districts.name: Sand Springs
districts.verbatim_quote: Although the Sand Springs district, which is 25 to 30 miles southeast of Fallon, was prospected in 1905, its first gold production was not until 1919.

districts.name: Wonder
districts.verbatim_quote: The Wonder district is on the west slope of the Clan Alpine Range in east Churchill County, 55 miles east of Fallon.

districts.name: Eldorado
districts.verbatim_quote: The Eldorado district is 6 miles wide and 12 miles long in the northern Opal Mountains in southeast- ern Clark County, about 25 miles south of Boulder City.

districts.name: Goodsprings
districts.verbatim_quote: The Goodsprings (Yell ow Pine) district com- prises several hundred square miles in the southern

districts.name: Searchlight
districts.verbatim_quote: Located in southeastern Clark County, 40 miles south of Boulder City and 22 miles east of Nipton, Calif., the Searchlight district is one of the more recently developed in the State; the first produc- tion was recorded in 1898.

districts.name: Edgemont
districts.verbatim_quote: The Edgemont district is in northern Elko County, on the west slope of the Centennial Range, about 10 miles north of Deep Creek.

districts.name: Gold Circle
districts.verbatim_quote: The Gold Circle district is 45 miles north of Battle Mountain, 50 miles northeast of Golconda, and 35 miles west of Tuscarora.

districts.name: Jarbidge
districts.verbatim_quote: The Jarbidge district is in northern Elko County about 60 miles west of the Utah State line and 5 miles south of the Idaho State line.

districts.name: Tuscarora
districts.verbatim_quote: The Tuscarora district is 45 miles northwest of Elko, near the headwaters of the South Fork of the Owyhee River.

districts.name: Divide
districts.verbatim_quote: The Divide (Gold Mountain) district, 5 miles south of Tonopah, has been primarily a silver camp; it was founded in 1901.

districts.name: Goldfield
districts.verbatim_quote: Located near the east border of Esmeralda County, 28 miles south of Tonopah, the Goldfield district is on the south rim of a desert basin which is the southern extension of a much larger basin west of Tonopah.

districts.name: Hornsilver
districts.verbatim_quote: In the Hornsilver district, which is 20 miles south-southwest of Goldfield, prospectors were ac- tive in 1868, but their discoveries were not very productive (Ransome, 1909b, p. 41-42).

districts.name: Lone Mountain
districts.verbatim_quote: Located in eastern Esmeralda County, in T. 1 S., R. 41 E., the Lone Mountain district is predomi- nantly a silver camp with a recorded production from 1903 through 1949 of 31,961 ounces of gold.

districts.name: Silver Peak
districts.verbatim_quote: The Silver Peak (Mineral Ridge) district is in central Esmeralda County, in T. 5 S., R. 39 E.

districts.name: Buckhorn
districts.verbatim_quote: The Buckhorn district is in the south end of the Cortez Mountains, 5 miles northeast of Cortez.

districts.name: Cortez
districts.verbatim_quote: The Cortez district is about 36 miles south of Beowawe at about the middle of the boundary line between Eureka and Lander Counties.

districts.name: Eureka
districts.verbatim_quote: The Eureka district is located at the town of Eureka, in southeastern Eureka County.

districts.name: Lynn
districts.verbatim_quote: Located about 20 · miles northwest of Carlin in northern Eureka County, the Lynn district was un- til 1962 a placer district.

districts.name: Awakening
districts.verbatim_quote: The Awakening district is about 45 miles north- west of Winnemucca in the Slumbering Hills.

districts.name: Dutch Flat
districts.verbatim_quote: The Dutch Flat placer district, 18 miles northeast of Winnemucca and 18 miles north of Golconda, was discovered in 1893 and produced about $75,000 in gold the first year (Vanderburg, 1936a, p. 94).

districts.name: Gold Run
districts.verbatim_quote: Located in southeast Humboldt County, 12 miles south of Golconda, the Gold Run (Adelaide) district was organized in 1866.

districts.name: National
districts.verbatim_quote: The National district is in northeastern Humboldt County on the west slope of the Santa Rosa Range, 18 miles southeast of McDermitt.

districts.name: Paradise Valley
districts.verbatim_quote: Located on the east slope of the Santa Rosa Range, 11 miles northwest of the town of Paradise Valley, the Paradise Valley district was discovered in 1868.

districts.name: Potosi
districts.verbatim_quote: The Potosi district is in T. 38 and 39 N., R. 42 E., in the northern Osgood Mountains.

districts.name: Warm Springs
districts.verbatim_quote: The Warm Springs district is in northwest Hum- boldt County near Denio, Oreg.

districts.name: Winnemucca
districts.verbatim_quote: The first discovery in this district, which is 4 miles northwest of the town of Winnemucca, was made in 1863 by an Indian named Winnemucca (Vanderburg, 1938a, p. 51-54).

districts.name: Battle Mountain
districts.verbatim_quote: The Battle Mountain district, in northwestern Lander County, includes the Battle Mountain Range, an area 15 miles long and 12 miles wide.

districts.name: Bullion
districts.verbatim_quote: The Bullion district is on the east slope of the Shoshone Range, 23 miles southwest of Beowawe, in sees. 8, 9, 16, and 17, T. 28 N., R. 47 E.

districts.name: Hilltop
districts.verbatim_quote: The Hilltop district is on the northwest slope of Shoshone Peak, 18 miles southeast of Battle Moun- tain, in sees. 3, 4, 5, and 6, T. 29 N., R. 46 E.

districts.name: Lewis
districts.verbatim_quote: The Lewis district is 17 miles southeast of Battle Mountain, in the southeast quarter of T. 30 N., R. 45 E.

districts.name: New Pass
districts.verbatim_quote: The New Pass district is on the east slope of New Pass Range near the boundary of Lander and Churchill Counties, 31 miles west of Austin.

districts.name: Reese River
districts.verbatim_quote: The Reese River district is in southern Lander County near Austin.

districts.name: Delamar
districts.verbatim_quote: The Delamar district is in south-central Lincoln County on the west slope of the Meadow Valley Range, 29 miles southwest of Caliente.

districts.name: Pioche
districts.verbatim_quote: The Pioche district is 19 miles west of the Utah- Nevada State line; the town of Pioche is the county seat of Lincoln County.

districts.name: Como
districts.verbatim_quote: The Como (Palmyra, Indian Springs) district is 10 miles southeast of Dayton.

districts.name: Silver City
districts.verbatim_quote: The Silver City district is in the western tip of Lyon County, in T. 16 N., R. 21 E.

districts.name: Wilson
districts.verbatim_quote: The Wilson (Pine Grove, Rockland, Cambridge) district is in south-central Lyon County in parts of Tps. 9 and 10 N., Rs. 25 and 26 E.

districts.name: Aurora
districts.verbatim_quote: The Aurora district is in western Mineral County, 3 miles east of the Nevada-California State line and 30 miles southwest of Hawthorne.

districts.name: Bell
districts.verbatim_quote: The Bell (Cedar Mountain) district is in the Cedar Mountain Range in eastern Mineral County near the Nye County border.

districts.name: Candelaria
districts.verbatim_quote: Silver veins were discovered in the Candelaria district, which is 22 miles south of Mina in the Candelaria Mountains, in 1863 by a party of Spaniards.

districts.name: Garfield
districts.verbatim_quote: The Garfield district is 10 miles northwest of Mina and 25 miles southeast of Hawthorne, just north of a line comiecting Hawthorne and Mina.

districts.name: Gold Range
districts.verbatim_quote: The Gold Range (Silver Star, Camp Douglas) district is in the Excelsior Mountains in southern Mineral County, about 7 miles northeast of Mina.

districts.name: Hawthorne
districts.verbatim_quote: The Hawthorne district, near the town of Haw- thorne at the south end of Walker Lake, is predomi- nantly a silver district, but it has produced con- siderable gold as a byproduct.

districts.name: Mount Montgomery and Oneota
districts.verbatim_quote: The Mount Montgomery and Oneota districts are combined here because they adjoin and are geologi- cally similar.

districts.name: Rawhide
districts.verbatim_quote: The Rawhide (Regent) district, at the south end of the Sand Springs Range in northeastern Mineral County, is 29 miles east of Schurz and 50 miles southeast of Fallon.

districts.name: Bruner
districts.verbatim_quote: The Bruner (Phomolite) district is in northwest- ern Nye County at !at 39°05' N. and long 117 6 46' E.

districts.name: Bullfrog
districts.verbatim_quote: The Bullfrog district is in southern Nye County, 60 miles south-southeast of Goldfield.

districts.name: Ellendale
districts.verbatim_quote: The Ellendale district is a few miles east of Tono- pah, in T. 2 N., R. 43 E.

districts.name: Gold Hill
districts.verbatim_quote: The Gold Hill district is 6 miles north of Round Mountain, in the southern Toquima Range, in T. 11 N., R. 44 E.

districts.name: Jackson
districts.verbatim_quote: The Jackson (Gold Park) district is on the west slope of the Shoshone Mountains in northwestern

districts.name: Jefferson Canyon
districts.verbatim_quote: The J e:fferson Canyon district is 6 miles north- east of Round Mountain (lat 38°43' N., long 117° E.) on the west slope of the Toquima Range.

districts.name: Johnnie
districts.verbatim_quote: The Johnnie district is in the extreme southeast part of Nye County (lat 36°26' N., long 116°04' E.).

districts.name: Lodi
districts.verbatim_quote: The Lodi (Granite, Marble, Quartz Mountains) district is in northwest Nye County (T. 13 W., R. 36 E.) .

districts.name: Manhattan
districts.verbatim_quote: Manhattan, at the south end of the Toquima Range about 35 miles north of Tonopah, is a gold district, silver being produced as a byproduct.

districts.name: Northumberland
districts.verbatim_quote: The Northumberland district on on the east side of Toquima Range, 25 miles north of Belmont and 76 miles northeast of Tonopah.

districts.name: Round Mountain
districts.verbatim_quote: The Round Mountain district is on the west flank of the Toquima Range, 45 miles north of Tonopah and about 8 miles north of Manhattan.

districts.name: Tonopah
districts.verbatim_quote: This district is in the southern San Antonio Mountains near Tonopah, the county seat of Nye County and the largest town in the county.

districts.name: Tybo
districts.verbatim_quote: The Tybo (Hot Creek, Keystone, Empire) district is in northeastern Nye County, in the Hot Creek Range, 65 miles northeast of Tonopah and about 100 miles southwest of Ely (lat 38°23' N., long 116°23' E.).

districts.name: Union
districts.verbatim_quote: The Union district, in northwestern Nye County in the Shoshone Range (lat 38°55' N., long 117°35' E.), was organized in 1863, and the town of lone was soon built.

districts.name: Humboldt
districts.verbatim_quote: The Humboldt (Imlay, Eldorado) district, on the north end and west flank of the Humboldt Range, was organized in 1860 as the first district in the area now included in Pershing County.

districts.name: Rochester
districts.verbatim_quote: In the Rochester district, in the central Humboldt Range 9 miles east of Oreana, activity began in the 1860's during the intensive search for silver in the Star Peak Range.

districts.name: Rye Patch
districts.verbatim_quote: The Rye Patch (Echo) district is on the west flank of the Humboldt Range in central Pershing County, 4 miles east of Rye Patch.

districts.name: Seven Troughs
districts.verbatim_quote: Located on the west slope of the Seven Troughs Range 30 miles west of Lovelock, the Seven Troughs district is primarily a gold-producing district, but the ores also contain considerable silver.

districts.name: Sierra
districts.verbatim_quote: The Sierra (Dun Glen, Chafey) district, at the north end of the East Rang~ in the northeast part of T. 33 N., R. 36 E., was founded in 1863 when lode gold and placer gold were discovered in the area.

districts.name: Spring Valley
districts.verbatim_quote: The Spring Valley district is on the east slope of the Humboldt Range, 14 miles east of Oreana.

districts.name: Comstock Lode
districts.verbatim_quote: The Comstock Lode district is in southern Storey County (lat 39°16' to 39°20' W., long 119°37' to 119°40' E.).

districts.name: Olinghouse
districts.verbatim_quote: The Olinghouse (White Horse) district is in southeast Washoe County (lat 39°40' N., long 119°25' E.), about 12 miles south of Pyramid Lake.

districts.name: Cherry Creek
districts.verbatim_quote: The Cherry Creek (Egan Canyon, Gold Canyon) district is in the Egan Range, 50 miles north of Ely.

districts.name: Ely
districts.verbatim_quote: The Ely (Robinson) district is slightly south of the center of White Pine County, 50 miles west of the Utah-Nevada boundary.

districts.name: Osceola
districts.verbatim_quote: The Osceola district is on the west slope of the Snake Range, 35 miles east of Ely.

source.citation: Koschmann, A. H., and Bergendahl, M. H., 1968, USGS Professional Paper 610.
source.title: Principal Gold-Producing Districts of the United States
